source.title: LYSAGHT Zeds and Cees Design and Installation Guide
pages: 13: PB1230HS M12 x 30 grade 8.8 purlin-bolt catalogue identity
17-18: Cee holes, 100AC cleats, orientation and bridging locations

references: AS/NZS 4600:2005 incorporating Amendment No. 1, clauses 4.3.2.1-4.3.2.3 and 5.3; SHA-256 9af589ce2bfee5a156c7f6600a738fcc158683bd27bea9d22adb559f172fc2d1

resistance.basis: The exact C10012, 100AC and two PB1230HS purlin-web bolt kits establish a physically capable lateral/twist-restraint candidate. Tertius calculates the 2.5% critical-flange force required by AS/NZS 4600:2005 clauses 4.3.2.2-4.3.2.3. Capacity and stiffness remain unverified because the rendered physical joint does not yet include the separate support-side shared bolts that connect the 100AC leg to the C10019 rafter.

assumptions: C10012 is a single-span secondary member between portal frames.
Each rendered purlin-web fastener is one PB1230HS M12 x 30 grade 8.8 bolt/nut/washer kit.
The 100AC-to-rafter support-side bolt group must be included in the same physical connection before resistance or stiffness can be credited.
A separate longitudinal roof-bracing or verified diaphragm path is required.
exclusions: No connection stiffness is inferred from bracket geometry.
No support-side bolt resistance is inferred from unlinked nearby geometry.
No rafter distortional-buckling resistance is inferred from purlin load tables.
No cladding-diaphragm capacity or collector anchorage is credited.

resistance.basis: The exact C10012, 100AC, 100CP and two PB1230HS purlin-web bolt kits establish a physically capable lateral/twist-restraint candidate at the open rafter face. assumptions: C10012 is a single-span secondary member between portal frames.
Each rendered purlin-web fastener is one PB1230HS M12 x 30 grade 8.8 bolt/nut/washer kit.
The 100CP is a rendered clamp plate and is not a substitute for the missing support-side bolt identity.
exclusions: No connection stiffness is inferred from bracket or clamp-plate geometry.
No support-side bolt resistance is inferred from unlinked nearby geometry.
No cladding-diaphragm or collector anchorage is credited.
